Fit a Royston-Parmar Flexible Parametric Survival Model

Source: R/fit_rpsurv.R
fit_rpsurv.Rd

Fits a Royston-Parmar flexible parametric survival model with the rpsurv package and returns an object compatible with the mlsurv_model interface. Restricted cubic splines model the baseline on the chosen scale, optionally with time-varying covariate effects (tve), so predicted survival curves are available at arbitrary time points without a proportional-hazards assumption.

Usage

fit_rpsurv(
  formula,
  data,
  df = 4,
  knots = NULL,
  tve = NULL,
  tve.df = 3,
  scale = c("hazard", "odds", "normal"),
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A survival formula Surv(time, status) ~ predictors.

data

A data.frame containing the formula variables.

df

Degrees of freedom for the baseline spline (default 4).

knots

Optional explicit knot vector (log time scale); default NULL derives knots from df.

tve

Optional character vector of covariate names given time-varying effects via their own restricted cubic spline.

tve.df

Degrees of freedom for each time-varying-effect spline (default 3).

scale

One of "hazard" (proportional hazards, default), "odds", or "normal".

...

Additional arguments passed to rpsurv::rpsurv() (for example control).

Value

An object of class "mlsurv_model" with elements model, learner ("rpsurv"), formula, data, time, status, plus rhs_terms/cov_terms/xlev used to rebuild the design matrix for arbitrary newdata at predict time.

See also

predict_rpsurv, rpsurv, fit for the verb interface

Examples

mod <- fit_rpsurv(Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + celltype, veteran, df = 3)
#> Warning: Hessian not invertible; standard errors unavailable
summary(mod)
#> 
#> ── rpsurv summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Formula:
#> Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + celltype
#> Engine: rpsurv
#> Learner: rpsurv
#> Data summary:
#> - Observations: 137
#> - Predictors: "age, karno, celltypesmallcell, celltypeadeno, celltypelarge"
#> - Time range: [1, 999]
#> - Event rate: "93.4%"
